profile.headline: Platform Software Engineer III at ExtraHop
profile.summary:
I graduated from the University of Washington, with a Human Centered Design and Engineering major B.S, a major that encompasses UX design and user research. Despite this, I have a wide spectrum of interest in various engineering disciplines.

I've currently spent the extent of my time at ExtraHop on the platform team working on a plethora of system level features.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Platform team
- Enabled a new SFF hardware Reveal(x) platform
- Built JBOD disk wipe feature for rescue USB
- Wrote a series of REST API endpoints to upgrade appliance firmware
- Wrote logic to transition the connection to ExtraHop Cloud Services gracefully when updating the appliance license
- Added a publisher of system health metrics to Record Store platform
- Allow client to query firmware upgrade progress via REST API at any point across system reboot, various services restarting, database restoration
- Added diagnostics page for the connection between an appliance and ExtraHop Cloud Services (TLS over HTTPS with optional customer provided proxy)
- Migrated all RAID controller interfacing code from using Megacli to Perccli for PERC11 RAID controllers on 14G Dell hardware
- Performed thousands of lines of refactoring of RAID firmware code to allow for scalability and added documentation for everything I touched
- Heavily involved in development and maintenance of PXE build server code that is used at contract manufacturing to build new and existing hardware platforms for customers

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Aid in researching beliefs about disability, human performance, and technology that influence stakeholder experiences of disability and rehabilitation by conducting interviews and focus groups with stakeholders, and performing qualitative analysis on stakeholder feedback. Write relevance and aggregation algorithms that take transcripts and clusters statements based on wording and diction.

company.name: University of Washington Steele Ability Lab

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Launched feature to browse and cancel reminders by name using substring matching and filtering.
- Integrated case handling for finding matching reminders while browsing and cancelling with a name query.
- Created 6 new voice prompts for Alexa’s voice user interface.
- Conducted user research to determine most effective voice responses.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Social trending news detection for Bing News answer. Wrote a multi-level Tweet clustering algorithm from scratch using various similarity algorithms in order to identify trending relevant and news-worthy stories and articles.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Aid in research using prototyping, ultrasound imaging, and musculoskeletal simulation in order to design and improve the means by which ankle foot orthoses improve movement, and optimize design to individual movement. Main role is motion capture and ultrasound data processing.

company.name: University of Washington Steele Ability Lab

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Full time instruction of various courses in programming, Minecraft modding, game design of children 8-12 years.

volunteerExperiences.description: Visited Malawi, which is located in central-eastern Africa. Currently the third poorest country in the world. Spent 3 weeks in a village called Chibwalo in order to teach the local children various subjects such as Math, English, Geography, various Sciences.

projects.title: Text Based Game
projects.description: Created an application for a simple text based game from scratch, including text file format and load, interface, and gameflow.

publications.title: FABRICATING AND EVALUATING ADJUSTABLE STIFFNESS 3D-PRINTED ANKLE FOOT ORTHOSIS
